Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: literary reading edition cover
Primary request: Create a mature, historically grounded cover illustration for Jane Austen's Persuasion. Anne Elliot, an elegant thoughtful Englishwoman aged 27 in accurate 1814 Regency dress, stands on the stone Cobb at Lyme Regis, seen in three-quarter profile, with Captain Wentworth in naval post-captain uniform farther behind and a windswept sea beyond. Emotional restraint, distance, constancy, second chances.
Style/medium: museum-quality oil painting blended with fine aquatint texture, natural faces, adult literary fiction, period accurate.
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3, strong clear silhouettes, room in the upper sky for app overlay, no written title in the image.
Lighting/mood: cool late-autumn coastal light with a narrow warm break in cloud.
Color palette: slate blue, weathered limestone, muted olive, warm cream.
Constraints: historically plausible 1814 clothing and harbor; no text, no watermark, no modern objects, no caricature, no collage.

Constraints: exactly 16 panels; no text, labels, borders inside portraits, watermark, modern objects, caricature, duplicate face, extra person, cropped head.
